label: Stipulated innocent and nonthreatening…: The model separately supplies innocent and nonthreatening…
definition: The model separately supplies innocent and nonthreatening predicates, each applied to the victim in the killing context; neither is defined from or entails the other.
note: These are separate factual case classifications, not definitions of legal guilt, moral innocence or threat, and not an identification with Aquinas’s innocent/righteous contrast. Their applicability to real cases requires independent support.

formal_gap.meaning: Facts.innocent c v says that, in the killing context c, the person v is innocent. It is a field of the typed hard-case facts (TruthCore.Ethics.HardCaseTyped.Facts), supplied by each model as an independent factual classification; the separate field nonthreatening classifies threat, and neither is defined from or entails the other.
examples: The victim of the hard case's deliberate killing, stipulated innocent in that context.
exclusions: Legal guilt or a theory of moral innocence.
Aquinas's innocent/righteous contrast: not identified with it (DISAMB-INNOCENCE-HARD-CASE-AQUINAS).
open_obligations: Applicability to real cases requires independent support.
No formalization candidate: a stipulated case classification.
